source.provider: Iranian Post address divisions (GNAF), republished by masterking32/iran-states-cities-districts
source.notes: Selectable places are Post cities plus county centers. County centers such as تهران and کرج are not repeated in the city rows, so both are included. Villages are omitted. Ids are prefixed with province, city, or county because Post reuses numbers across those lists. Three province labels gain the conventional Persian spacing.
